Images go to a free or custom OpenAI-compatible vision API; the exact description sent to the "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"configured reasoning model is then committed to the DSH session and replayed as ordinary text."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The default is LLM7.io's anonymous `default` vision route. No local VLM, GPU, account, or vision API"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" key is required for its documented anonymous allowance. No local VLM, GPU, or multi-gigabyte model "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"download is required."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this plugin"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **No-key hosted vision default.** On top of a working DSH text route, the default LLM7.io vision e"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ndpoint works without registration or a vision key; an LLM7 token is optional for higher limits.
- *"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"*Durable and replayable.** VLM output is a real DSH session message, not a hidden request-time rewri"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"te or process-only cache.
- **No image overhead for text.** The vision provider is contacted only wh"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"en an undescribed image exists.
- **Replaceable reasoning target.** The sidecar forwards to `targetP"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"rovider` and `targetModel`; any DSH text route that does not depend on opaque provider replay state "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"can be selected.
- **Fail-loud.** Missing credentials, timeouts, rate limits, and provider failures "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"remain typed errors. The plugin never silently forwards an image to a text-only model.
- **Build-fre"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"e Git install.** The repository ships native ESM JavaScript, so pnpm does not need permission to run"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" a `prepare` script."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Requires DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` or newer within the `0.1.x` line and Node.js `22.19+` or `24+`."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Quick start: no-key hosted vision"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Before starting, have a DSH Web profile that can already call its text model. LLM7.io documents anonymo"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"us access up to 500,000 tokens/day, 60 requests/hour, 10 requests/minute, and 1 request/second; thes"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"e limits and model availability can change. Your selected reasoning route keeps its existing credent"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ial, quota, and billing rules."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"There is deliberately no shared or embedded API key. LLM7.io's anonymous allowance is provider-enfor"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ced; any optional authenticated key remains user-owned and is never stored in this package."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Add a custom vision model from the Models page"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"DeepSeek Desktop already includes the model settings page, so the plugin reuses it instead of adding"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" a second credential form. 3. Choose `openai-completions` and add at least one visi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"on model ID.
4. Paste your own key into the API key field and apply. DSH stores it write-only throug"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"h the credentials service, not in `settings.yaml`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Point the sidecar at the route saved by the page:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`visionModel: default` selects the first model listed for that route; you can instead enter an exact"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" model ID. The vision route must speak OpenAI Chat Completions; Responses and Anthropic protocols ca"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"nnot be used directly as this plugin's vision endpoint. Select **DeepSeek + Hosted Vision** in the c"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"onversation model picker to send images. The reasoning call still uses `targetProvider`/`targetModel"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"`, so the Desktop text model does not need to change."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## What happens to an image"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. DSH resolves the image from its verified attachment store.
2. The plugin sends a bounded batch to"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" the configured OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint.
3. Only after every batch succeeds, "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"the exact visual description and attachment SHA-256 IDs are appended to the durable session as an un"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"trusted-evidence notice.
4. Images are replaced with deterministic text pointers before the configur"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ed text model is called.
5. Later turns reuse the logged description, including after a process rest"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"art. They do not spend the free VLM quota again."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Text detected inside an image is explicitly framed as untrusted data before it reaches the reasoning"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" model.
